title: Degraded Mode und manuelle Wiederholung
description: As a developer, I want the platform to keep working while the AI service is down and to let me retry later, so that an outage does not stop my team.

acceptance_criteria.given: the AI service is down and the queue fills up
acceptance_criteria.when: the developer creates and reads prompts
acceptance_criteria.then: the API responds normally and the queued scans wait
and: no request fails with an AI related error and no data is lost
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-033-degraded-mode.feature: An AI outage does not stop the write path

acceptance_criteria.given: several scan jobs are queued while the AI service is down
acceptance_criteria.when: the AI service becomes available again
acceptance_criteria.then: the jobs are processed in their original order
and: each version ends in a final status
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-033-degraded-mode.feature: Queued jobs are processed in order after recovery

acceptance_criteria.given: a version is in status FAILED
acceptance_criteria.then: a new scan job is created and the version moves to PENDING and later to a final status
and: the manual retry is recorded in the audit trail
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-033-degraded-mode.feature: A failed scan can be retried manually
